data.rationale: The proposal gets the procedure right, in the right order: From and To with suggestions, trip type and dates, Search, Continue, then Sort & Filter and Apply. Its main flaw is folding payment type (Points) and the sort option into one 'sort_or_fare_option' parameter, when they should be two separate parameters applied one after the other. Its last step is also a bit vague about the Default dropdown and the Points filter clicks.
